title: Crossover Pilot Model
text: 表示 Crossover Pilot Model，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Type of control} 指定动力学控制；{Calculated value} 指定穿越频率或飞行员增益 Crossover、{Controlled element gain} 指定受控对象增益、{Pilot gain} 指定飞行员增益、{Crossover frequency (rad/s)} 指定穿越频率、{Pilot time delay(s)} 指定飞行员时间延迟、{Pilot lead constant} 指定飞行员超前常数、{Pilot lag constant} 指定飞行员滞后常数，按实例取值。

params.name: Type of control
params.values: 动力学控制 Proportional (default) | Rate or velocity | Spiral divergence | Second order - Short period | Acceleration(*) | Roll attitude(*) | Unstable short period(*) | Second order - Phugoid(*)

params.name: Calculated value
params.values: 穿越频率或飞行员增益 Crossover frequency (default) | Pilot gain

params.name: Crossover frequency (rad/s)
params.values: 穿越频率 3 (default) | scalar in the range of 1 and 10
